recruitment_manoeuvre_detail.value: Pressure control ventilation, PEEP 15 cm H2O, RR 10/min, I:E 1:1, pressure control +15 cm H2O; PEEP increased by 5 cm H2O every 30 seconds up to 30 cm H2O + 15 cm H2O; total duration 2 minutes.

provenance.quote: The patient's ventilatory mode was switched to pressure control ventilation, with PEEP of 15 cm H2O, respiratory rate of 10 breaths/min, inspiratory/expiratory ratio of 1:1, and a pressure control level of +15 cm H2O. Every 30 seconds, PEEP was increased by 5 cm H2O. We progressively increased PEEP to 30 cm H2O + 15 cm H2O of pressure control. The total duration of the RM was 2 minutes.

provenance.quote: Subjects' EELVs and respiratory mechanics were studied at clinically set PEEP (baseline PEEP), zero PEEP (ZEEP), lowest PEEP level with a positive Ptpe without a recruitment maneuver (RM), lowest PEEP level with a positive Ptpe after a RM, best decremental PEEP after a RM, and best decremental PEEP with the head of bed elevated to 30 degrees.
provenance.location: Methods, Population and Study Protocol, p. 301

crossover_order.value: Fixed sequence as listed: baseline PEEP, ZEEP, lowest PEEP with positive Ptpe without RM, lowest PEEP with positive Ptpe after RM, best decremental PEEP after RM, best decremental PEEP with head of bed 30 degrees. Not randomised ('patients were not subject to a randomized application of differently titrated PEEP levels').

provenance.quote: First, patients were not subject to a randomized application of differently titrated PEEP levels.
provenance.location: Discussion, Limitations, p. 306

washout_or_stabilisation.value: Best decremental PEEP: after 2 minutes at the starting level, Pplat and PEEP measured with pauses, PEEP decreased by 2 cm H2O, repeated for at least five decrements.

provenance.quote: After 2 minutes, Pplat and PEEP were measured with end-inspiratory and end-expiratory pauses. The delta pressure (Pplat – PEEP) was then calculated, and PEEP was decreased by 2 cm H2O. The procedure was repeated for at least five decrements, until the PEEP level with the lowest delta pressure was determined
provenance.location: Methods, PEEP Titration Techniques and RMs, Best Decremental PEEP, p. 301

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md initially suspected pirrone_2016 as part of mgh_lung_rescue; this was refuted on the three required checks. (1) Registration differs: Pirrone is NCT 02105220 / IRB 2013P001413; Fumagalli is NCT02503241 / IRB 2015P001515. (2) Enrolment does not overlap: Fumagalli enrolled April 2016 to July 2017, after Pirrone was published (February 2016). (3) Eligibility criteria are contradictory: Pirrone excludes ARDS ('absence of a diagnosis of acute respiratory distress syndrome as defined by the Berlin criteria') whereas the mgh_lung_rescue reports require ARDS. Cohort therefore treated as unique to this report; cohort_id null.

outcomes (ventilator_settings).paired_effects: the abstract reports the two titration methods' PEEP levels as '20.7 ± 4.0 vs 21.3 ± 3.8 cm H2O; p = 0.40' while the Results text reports p = 0.37 for the same contrast; both recorded, discrepancy flagged.
population.predicted_body_weight_kg: EELV and tidal volume are expressed per kg ideal body weight but no predicted body weight value is reported.
eligibility.criteria.adults_18_plus: explicit age criterion stated, so coded yes without inference; noted for completeness.
data_only_in_figure: Hemodynamic values (systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, heart rate) at each PEEP condition appear only in Figure 5 and would require digitisation.
EELV and transpulmonary pressure trajectories are also plotted in Figures 1 and 2, but the underlying values are available in Table 2.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Nonrandomized physiologic crossover in 14 morbidly obese patients; no clinical outcomes (mortality, ventilator-free days, length of stay) reported. Transient hypotension during the final steps of the RM occurred in 5 of 14 patients ('Only five of 14 patients experienced transient hypotension (systolic arterial blood pressure < 90 mm Hg) during the final steps of the RM', Results p. 303) — attributed to the recruitment maneuver, not the balloon, so it is recorded here rather than in balloon_related_complications. Average error between repeated EELV measurements was 8.7 ± 7.8% (Results p. 302). After the study, attending physicians were free to adjust PEEP; no data on poststudy PEEP decisions beyond Tables S1/S2 (supplemental, not provided). Some results previously presented as an abstract (Pirrone 2014, Crit Care Med 42:A1523).
